notes.title: Controller Issue - how to fix it?
notes.content:
Hi guys, 
some of you have encountered a problem with a controller. 

The issue is related to the Steam bug, that might be hard to fix from our side. Since [h1]there is a workaround known to fix the issue[/h1], I suggest sticking to it. 

Mentioned workaround: 
1. Open Steam Library.
2. Find and Right-click on the Steel Rats.
3. Choose the "Properties" as shown on the first screen
4. In GENERAL tab open the drop down list under the "Steam Input Per-Game Setting".
5. Select Forced On as shown on the second screen.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33040674/2cc5f19b287d8ecc17d9865632b8027ac013e669.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33040674/5f6fe75da6071beb048e02d25f0f286c2cddb0f2.jpg[/img]

Sorry for the inconvenience and we hope that from now on you can fully experience gameplay of Steel Rats.

notes.title: Steel Rats Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33040674/d099be973b50673e36091e04b9d55f88a5313e01.jpg[/img]

Hiya Bikers, 
As the developer we're keen to hear from you. We gather every bit of feedback, we are getting and we plan to use it to improve our game, based on your feelings.
Update Includes following tweaks and changes: 

[list]
[*] Balanced HP, Energy, Junk and Points amount needed to unlock Abilities 
[*] Motorcycles Max Speed is decreased (however max speed with wheelsaw turned on is the same)
[*] Usage of wheelsaw now consumes Energy
[*] BB ability doesn’t consume Energy anymore
[*]  When attacking with Wheelsaw, Motorcycle will auto-target to the nearest Junkbot
[*] Vertical riding restores Energy (Wheelsaw FX colored blue)
[*]  Motorcycles are heavier, they don’t flip upside down so easily 
[*]  Drone Junkbots attack faster and deal more Damage
[*]  Hitting the walls at high-speed results in a crash and losing HP 
[*] Falling upside down results in a crash and losing HP
[*] Barbed Wire doesn't stop motorcycle anymore
[*] Reminders of Tutorials added (we display some crucial controls instructions for the second time so you don’t have to worry about skipping them)
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Hope that those changes will maximize your fun with Steel Rats
Let us know in the comments below or on our social media channels what you think!
